shots.excerpt: Low-angle wide: the witch walks calmly through the courtyard; behind her the frozen tiered fountain with icicles, the twins peeking out from behind it, grinning.
shots.voice: Shot 1. A low-angle wide. She walks past the frozen fountain while two twins hide behind it.

shots.excerpt: The snowball smashes into the back of her shoulder in a burst of snow spray, braid whipping; close-up push-in as her eyes snap open into a cold glare.
shots.voice: Shot 4. The snowball bursts on her shoulder, then a push-in as her eyes snap open in a glare.

shots.excerpt: Close side tracking shot at high speed: the witch sprints low and fast, braid streaming behind her, snow streaking past.
shots.voice: Shot 7. A fast side tracking shot keeps her face sharp while the snow streaks past.

shots.excerpt: Wide side tracking along a long arcade, roof piled with snow and icicles: the twins race past the columns with the witch close behind.
shots.voice: Shot 11. A wide tracking shot along the arcade, and the snow piled on the roof sets up the ending.

shots.excerpt: Close-up of the twin, smug and grinning, chin raised, unaware.
shots.voice: Shot 15. A smug close-up. He has no idea what is coming.

shots.excerpt: The whole mass of roof snow slides off in an avalanche and buries the twins; they end up buried to their necks while the witch tugs her gloves tight.
shots.voice: Shot 19. The roof avalanche buries them to their necks, and she just tightens her gloves.
